job.title: Kitchen faucet replacement + garbage disposal install
job.description: Remove existing kitchen faucet and garbage disposal, install customer-supplied faucet and a new 1/2 HP disposal unit, test for leaks.

line_items.description: Supply lines, P-trap fittings, plumber's putty

notes: Assumes existing shutoff valves are functional; if corroded valves need replacement, that is an additional $25-40/valve, billed after inspection. Customer to supply faucet.
terms: Estimate valid for 30 days. 50% deposit due at scheduling, balance due on completion. Prices are estimates and may adjust if hidden conditions are found once work begins.
